title: Clear the ‘Tip of the Tongue’ Block
description: To unblock stuck memories: - Relax: Take deep breaths and stop stressing over the word or idea. - Use hints: Think of related words, phrases, or contexts. - Distract yourself: Do something else for a while; it often pops up later. Example: If you can’t recall a name, focus on where you met the person or other details about them.
